title: Django 5.0.13 release notes | Django documentation | Django
content:
Django 5.0.13 fixes a security issue with severity “moderate” in 5.0.12.

The wrap() and wordwrap template filter were subject to a potential denial-of-service attack when used with very long strings.

headings.text: CVE-2025-26699: Potential denial-of-service vulnerability in django.utils.text.wrap()¶
